--- Page 7 --- (i) AGANSOANI 1934 bilsio London songjinmao International Congress of An- thropological aro Ethnological Science students-rang tom'e dal'a nielaaniko dakaha.
Ua tomanio chanchiani“"Know thyself' chongmotan na'a antangko uibo ingipa japang kattako ra'e gisik a'ning bite chanchianiko dakaha.
la senggipa matgipa kotokan New Delhi-oba 1978 bilsio apsan japang kattako ra'c tom'aniko dakaha.
A'gilsak gimikni delegaterang sak 3500 sokchimongaha.

Delhi-o chanchianio mongsongbate Indiani Tribal manderangni gimin chanchibataha. Indiao Tribal jatni mamalrang 200-na baten dongachim aro uamang ku'sikming 150 dingtang dingtang kusikrangko aganachim.

la tom'ani a'gilsakni onghachenganiko sandie sakki on'na mangiparang (palacontologists) aro janggi gnanggipa mamaloni mande ongbachenga ine sakki ongiparangba (Evolutionary biologist) tom'ao donge namen chanchigrikbeaha.
Uamang Charles Darwin Evolution Theory-ko compare and contrast- dingtanggrikaniko uina japang jadil, anchi minsuko nisusaha.
Maina Charles Darwin evolution theory gitade mandea chengode ki'me donggijagipa dalgipa makkre-oni (Orang-Outang) ong"baachim ine namen bilake sakkiko on'achim.
Mitam A'chikrangni gimin kitap segiparang A'chikrangko dalgipa makkre-rangna gadangsa batkalesan mesokaiaha.
Miksongani na'a an'tangko uichengna nanga, badia songoni, mai jat aro mai kusikko agana, uan behe chongmot ong'a.

Ia pilakko mangope “MEGHALAYA A'DOK-O DONGGIPA GARO HILLS-NI A'CHIKRANG “ ine kitapko bimung donaha, aro kitapko anga amani kusikchi seaha. Maina banga skia mangipa A'chik-rang aro gipin jatrangba A'chikrangni gimin English kusikchisa seani gimin aro hajalni hajal A'chikrang English-ko poraina mankugijagiparang dongenigkuani gimin, jatang Amani kusikchi sena sikbeaha.
Achik a'song ong'na skang nangni ambi atchu badia a'songo dongachim aro mai kusikko aganachim, uarangko uina joton ka'e sandichina angni seani miksonga ong'a.
Dao dongenggipa A'chik a'song jekon British-ni sason ka'mitingo Garo Hills ine bimung mingahachim unon A'chikrang chengonin dongchenggiparang ong'a ine na'aba bebe ra'ama ?
(autochonous) bilange dongena manaia.

uagita chengode mandenaba rakgipa champengani dongjachim ine Itihaas anchingna sakkiko on'a' Jakai Ispae1 manderang --- Page 8 --- (ii) Egypt A'songon1 bilsi 430 dongani jamano Canaan A'songchina reongkatangaha ine Reo.
Odhai 12:40-ni gita uina man'a.
Ritcha bilsirangna skang Africani Negrorang America-chi nokkol etna rimanganiko man'e jelbra jelsuaha gita. Daosa America-ni manderang "Africans to Africa" ine aganpilengaha.
Ua gita Achikrangko Tibet apil jangsaoni brangrorobae dao dongenggipa A'chik A'song, jekon Garo hills minga unona sokbaaha anga antangko uina nanga aro kusiktangko gamchatnikna nanga.
Jekal poedo segipa saksa A'chik me'apa indake seaha" Pangnaba chamgija A'king gore, Aganja gipin kutangna agre" - Surendro Sintang Marak.
ua kutangni gamchataniko raken sakkiko on'e donangaha.
A'chikrango M.A.
degree-ko pass ka'chenggipa Prof.

H.W.Momin indake seaha," Sako bile Do'drangmangba mikoronga sulni kurangna agre gipin do'oni kurang ba sulchi mikojachim ine uni miksongani ong'a. Indiani Salgro Salaram A'kitiko donggipa A'brini A'dokrangoni “MEGHALAYA A'SONG" atchiaha, 1972 bilsini January 20-gipa walni waljatchio (12 O'clock midnight) million-ni milliom Indiani manderangni sari gri tusiengmitingo "Meghalaya" atchiaha, indake manderangna gital janggi tangani sal nabaaha.
"We want Hills State, No Hills State, No rest".
Chingna A'brini Sorkariko nanga, manjaskal dontongjawa ine chrik abokanirangko gamchakgipa ‘Rongkuchak' (Echo) dongjaha.
January jao Shillongo namen sinbeoba, hajalni hajal manderang sorokjoljol rejinmae kasrok kasrok cheani gitrangko ring'e dalbea Isolni patianiko unwalo gisik ra'aha.
1972-ni January 20-ni walni 11:50 P.M.
bajio, Autonomous Meghalaya State-ni Chief Minister, Capt.
Williamson A. Sangma re- signed ka'aha.
Indiba minute 10-ni jamano, 1972, January 20-ni waljatchio “Full Pledged" State-ko Meghalaya manahani gimin Capt.
Sangma, Meghalaya Full Pledged State-ni Chief Minister ong'taina gita, uni seoke donsoimin, uni minster-rang baksa His Excellency, the Governor of Meghalaya, Shri B.K.
Nehru-chi Meghalaya-ko sason ka'na dongimin niam gita kumikchetaniko daktaiaha.

jemangan Assam-ni Goalpara aro Kamrup district-rango donggipa A'chikrang manpajaha.
Barlin Great Wall-ko salsaogoaha gita ia mandeni dakgipa geographical ari-simako salsao anchingna ogen. Ia kitapko anga bak 5 dake toktok sualaha.
Bak-1, British Garo Hills-ko maika1 chapataha.
Bak - 2, British-ni somoio Assam Government-ni sason mongsongbate Garo Hills-n1 gimin.
Bak - 3, India jakgitelko manmano Assam-ko sason ka'anio A'chikrang maidakgipa sasonni bilrangko Meghalaya atchina skang manaha.
Bak-4, Maikai Meghalaya State-ko manaha.
Bak - 5, Garo Hills District Council aro uni sason-ni gimin aditako mesokaha.
Capt. Sangma-ni ka'donge aro niksamsoe re'dilanichisa Garo, Khasi aro Jaintiana dingtang State Meghalaya-ko man'aha.
Anga uko Gisik ra'na gitasa ia chongipa kitap-ko A'chikkuchi seaha.
Uni gimin uni jagamgipa bimangko kitapni a'bachengao donaha.
Poraigiparangko molmola maina gualanirang dongnaba donga, uarangko angna uiatpilode anga mitelbegen.
Chai ku'dimna gitik, tom'e minokna gitik dakgipa ku'mitimchi sena sikoba, gisik a'ning bitjae kuwakmachisa seaha.
katta Doro ringgipani ring gita, "Kore bima redingko mala, Asillikma a'ningko bita" ineba anga rasong chajane.
Angni Salgro-Salaramni A'chikku, Late Rangam G. Momin aro late Dingmin Nengminza-ni Dictionary-oniko jakalaha.
Ia kitap-ko poraigipa sakantikon mitelbegen.
